deadline_semantics.0: required Bench entrant must be placed during the current turn
deadline_semantics.1: required Bench entrant becomes available on the player's next own turn and must be placed that turn

findings.attack_release: misses a same-turn Bench deadline but can preload Bench capacity for the next own turn
findings.supporter_release: its quota cost does not carry across the turn boundary; a next-turn required Supporter gets a fresh quota
findings.attack_contention: an attack release conflicts with a distinct current-turn attack objective unless the release attack itself satisfies that objective
findings.item_release: a pre-attack Item release can preserve the current attack window while preloading future Bench capacity
